verdict.rationale: Clipboard history is a fair capability to ask of a desktop OS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only shows Universal Clipboard copy/paste between devices (macos-docs-5, macos-docs-21) and the pbcopy/pbpaste CLI tools (macos-comm-13). None of that is a clipboard history of past text and image items reachable with a hotkey, so this is an adjacent feature, not the capability itself.
